Explore an M.S. or Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering
Colloids and Interface Science
The study of colloids and interface science have applications in a broad range of areas that include the chemical industry, biotechnology, nanotechnology, pharmaceuticals and more.
SCBME faculty experts include:
Reza Foudazi
Brian Grady
John Klier
Edgar O'Rear
Dimitrios Papavassiliou
Sepideh Razavi
Alberto Striolo
Catalysis and Reaction Engineering
The study of catalysis and reaction engineering includes the control and understanding of networks of reactions that occur at the cellular-level and their impacts. These actions react with the introduction of heat, light, electricity or chemical energy.
SCBME faculty experts include:
Steven Crossley
Kasun Goonasoryia
Lliangliang Huang
Lance Lobban
Daniel Resasco
Bin Wang
Environmental and Sustainability Engineering
The study of environmental and sustainability engineering focuses on environmental challenges faced both locally and internationally while providing solutions that are sustainabile and lasting. Students learn how to design products that promote sustainability for both the environment and human health
CBME faculty experts include:
Ngoc Bui
Reza Foudazi
Jie Gao
Michelle Galizia
Brian Grady
John Klier
Lance Lobban
Daniel Resasco
Alberto Striolo
Bio-Pharmaceutical Engineering
The study of bio-pharmaceutical engineering is where discovery, formulation and manufacturing meet targeted drug delivery to benefit cancer patients and more.
SCBME faculty experts include:
Roger Harrison
John Klier
Matthias Nollert
Edgar O'Rear III
Dimitrios Papavassiliou
Vassilios I. Sikavitsas

Why SCBME at OU?
OU is a highly ranked and reputable research university:
The Gallogly College is ranked in the Top 100 Best Engineering Graduate Schools by U.S. News and World Report for 2023.
The Princeton Review ranks OU among the best in the nation in terms of academic excellence and cost for students.
OU has achieved the Carnegie Foundations highest tier of research activity classification.
OU Chemical Engineering Graduate Program offers a competitive stipend package to students on assistantships!
You can enter the Ph.D. program without obtaining an M.S. degree first. Annual stipends are also available for M.S. students.
We accept both M.S. and Ph.D. applicants. Master’s students often stay for their Ph.D. degrees.
Financial Support
OU Chemical Engineering Graduate Program offers a competitive stipend package to students on assistantships!
You can enter the Ph.D. program without obtaining an M.S. degree first. Annual stipends are also available for M.S. students.
We accept both M.S. and Ph.D. applicants. Master’s students often stay for their Ph.D. degrees.
We have expense paid visits to the campus available for qualified students located in the U.S.!
Just email chegrad@ou.edu to let us know you are interested in discussing a visit. Include your resume and a copy of your transcript. In addition, students who meet the criteria and are invited for a visit will have their university application fee paid for by the department.
Where can I go with a SCBME graduate degree?
Our graduates are employed by reputable U.S. and international companies that include:
3M, Abengoa, Agilent, AMD, Baker Hughes, BASF, Chevron, Clorox, ConocoPhillps, Drom Fragrances, Dupont, ExxonMobil, Gore and Associates, Halliburton, Imation, Intel, Master Foods/Mars, Micromeritics, Nanofilm Ltd., Procter & Gamble, Schlumberger, Shell Oil Company, U.S. Navy, U.S. Patent Office, and Unilever.
Our Post-Docs have secured positions at these institutions:
University of Bristol, England; University of California-Berkeley; University of Delaware; Heriot Watt University, Edinburgh, UK; Massachusetts Institute of Technology, National Institute of Standards and Technology, University of Ontario, Canada; Pacific Northwestern National Laboratory.
Our graduates have secured faculty positions at these institutions:
University of California Davis; Chulalongkorn University, Thailand; EAFIT University, Colombia; Feng chia University, Taiwan; University of Kansas; Kasetsart University, Thailand; King Mohammed V University, Morocco; King Saud University, Saudi Arabia; University of Kuwait; University of Mississippi; National Chung Hsing University, Taiwan; University of Nevada-Reno; New Jersey Institute of Technology, University of Oklahoma, Oxford University, England; Rowan University; University of Toronto, University of Twente, the Netherlands.
